substantive_reconstruction.normalization_and_directed_planes: Set J†J=I,P=JJ†,R=2P-I. Exact J†UJ=A implies ||Ax||≤||x||, so a unit Hermitian eigenvector has t∈[-1,1]; J†U†J=A. For |t|<1 let p=Jv,s=sqrt(1-t²),q=(U†p-tp)/s,q'=(Up-tp)/s. Their entire clean projections vanish, not merely overlap with p, and each squared leakage norm is1-t². Thus (p,q),(p,q') are ordered orthonormal bases. Unitarity U†U=UU†=I gives Up=tp+sq',Uq=sp-tq',U†p=tp+sq,U†q'=sp-tq. U is forward, U† reverse; no bidirectional bare-U claim or distinct-plane inference is justified.
substantive_reconstruction.paired_rotation: Let S=[[t,s],[s,-t]],Z=diag(1,-1),M=SZ=[[t,-s],[s,t]]. R has Z in both directed bases because q,q' are flag-orthogonal. Reading E=U†RUR right-to-left gives SZSZ=M², a rotation by2theta with theta=arccos(t),s=sin(theta)>0. This is an endomorphism of H even when U itself need not preserve H.
substantive_reconstruction.powers_projection_and_k_zero: M^m has diagonal T_m(t), upper-right -s U_(m-1)(t), lower-left +s U_(m-1)(t). Hence for k≥1, E^k p=T_(2k)(t)p+sU_(2k-1)(t)q; UR E^k p=T_(2k+1)(t)p+sU_(2k)(t)q' for k≥0. E^0 is separatelyI; no undefined negative-index polynomial is required. Applying J† kills leakage and spectral basis assembly proves the two exact operator compressions. It is not necessary to assume every input is an eigenvector or normalized for those linear identities.
substantive_reconstruction.endpoints: At t=±1, ||Up||=||U†p||=1 and the clean part already has norm1, so Up=tp,U†p=tp. Then E p=p,UR E^k p=tp, matching T_even(±1)=1,T_odd(±1)=±1. No division by s=0, forced two-dimensional sector or freely chosen normalized zero leakage is used. A=0 is an interior t0 case and is covered.
substantive_reconstruction.first_counterexample_exact: For t=1/2,s=sqrt(3)/2 take A=tI2 and U=[[t,-s],[s,t]]⊗I2. It is unitary and non-Hermitian. With R=diag(I2,-I2), UR=[[t,s],[s,-t]]⊗I2 and (UR)²=I4; clean squareI2 differs from T2(A)=-I2/2. Here q=-|1>v and q'=|1>v, so H=H' as geometric subspaces but ordered bases differ by sign. Coincident planes do not suffice for repeated use of the same between-basis matrix.
substantive_reconstruction.second_counterexample_all_orders: In ancilla-major basis take Ustar=[[t,0,s,0],[0,1,0,0],[s,0,-t,0],[0,0,0,i]],Astar=diag(t,1),t=1/2. Its real reflection block on indices0,2 squares toI, index1 has phase1 and index3 phasei: unitary but not Hermitian. UstarR is M on indices0,2,1 on index1 and -i on unused index3. Its clean block at EVERY integer j≥0 is diag(Tj(t),1)=Tj(Astar). This is an all-j invariant-block proof, not inference from finitely sampled powers. The global non-Hermitian completion phase is outside the reached clean dynamics. Thus pairing is sufficient for all admissible completions, not necessary for every individual completion.
